question: Using NVIDIA's reported Q1 and Q2 FY2027 revenue plus the midpoint of its Q3 FY2027 outlook, what is the implied revenue for the first three quarters of FY2027, and the growth vs the first three quarters of FY2026?
grading: Implied 9M revenue ±0.5% (USD millions); growth ±0.5pp; must state which values are actual vs guidance
answer: Implied first-three-quarter FY2027 revenue is USD 285,836 million: Q1 actual USD 81,615 million + Q2 actual USD 96,221 million + Q3 guidance midpoint USD 108,000 million. [G23-E1] Against FY2026 nine-month actual revenue of USD 147,811 million, growth is 93.3794%. [G23-E2] This combines two actual quarters and one guided quarter; it is not reported nine-month revenue. The six-month filing total differs from the sum of the displayed quarters by USD 1 million due to rounding. [G23-E3]

| Quarter | Revenue |
|---------|---------|

| Q2 FY2027 (reported) | **$96.2B** |

| **Total 9 Months FY2027** | **$285.8B** |

Sources: [Q1 FY2027](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-q1-fy2027-earnings-record-214649637.html), [Q2 FY2027](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/nvidia-96b-quarter-proves-compute-222203690.html), [Q3 FY2027 guidance midpoint](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-just-doubled-sales-sold-021607724.html)

## Comparison vs. First Three Quarters of FY2026

| Quarter | Revenue |
|---------|---------|
| Q1 FY2026 (reported) | **$44.06B** |
| Q2 FY2026 (reported) | **$46.7B** |
| Q3 FY2026 (reported) | **$57.0B** |
| **Total 9 Months FY2026** | **$147.76B** |

Sources: [Q1 FY2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/most-covered-stock-earth-unstoppable-153658420.html), [Q2 FY2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/earnings/NVDA-Q2-2026-earnings_call-351238.html), [Q3 FY2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/nvidia-posts-31-9bn-net-085459256.html)

## Growth

- **Absolute increase:** $285.8B − $147.76B = **+$138.0B**
- **Year-over-year growth:** **~93.4%**

In summary, the first three quarters of FY2027 imply approximately **$285.8 billion in revenue**, representing roughly **93% growth** versus the comparable year-ago period ($147.8 billion).
